hero.alt: Illuminated canon table from the Garima Gospels, an early Ge'ez Gospel manuscript from Ethiopia
hero.caption: Canon table from Garima Gospel I, preserved at Abba Garima monastery in Ethiopia. Recent radiocarbon and orthographic research supports an Aksumite date for the oldest Garima manuscripts.

gundaGunde.alt: Illuminated Ge'ez Gospel leaf from Ethiopia, circa 1540
gundaGunde.caption: Leaf from the Gunda Gunde Gospels, Ethiopia, circa 1540. The later manuscript illustrates the difference between the age of a textual tradition and the date of an individual surviving copy.
